description: The contractual sequence after a missed monthly payment or a missed balloon on a CMBS loan, day by day: transfer to the special servicer, SEC delinquency status codes, the appraisal reduction trigger and deadline, the 120-day maturity window, each with its PSA section. Give days_elapsed to get which events have already been triggered and the next one with days remaining.

days_elapsed.description: Days since the missed payment due date or the maturity date. Omit to get the full sequence.

trigger.description: missed_payment = a monthly payment went unpaid; missed_balloon = the loan was not repaid at maturity.

name: special_servicing_timeline
title: CMBS special servicing timeline
